sources.excerpt: N5+ by Sinvertek | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Sinvertek N5+ LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS DISTORTION PREAMP Description Designed as a feature-rich, high-gain preamplifier and distortion unit, this pedal replicates the complex gain structures and response of high-end tube amplifiers. It incorporates extensive tone-shaping controls, including a multi-band EQ alongside parametric toggle switches to adjust gain saturation, low-end response, and mid-range voicings. Operating through all-analog circuitry, it offers multiple boost modes to alter volume and gain staging via the footswitch. The unit is built to maintain clarity and dynamic pick attack even under extreme saturation levels. Designed to integrate cleanly into any rig, it can function either as an front-of-amp drive unit or as a standalone preamp feeding a power amplifier.
